subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Counterfeit Products Online
description: A quick, practical guide to Counterfeit Products Online.

hook.text: You buy designer shoes online for 70% off. They arrive — wrong size, wrong material, wrong everything.

buildup.text: Counterfeit goods account for 3.3% of world trade — over $500 billion annually.

discovery.text: Fake luxury goods fund organized crime. Some counterfeit products are genuinely dangerous.

twist.text: Counterfeit electronics and medications have caused injuries, fires, and even deaths.

climax.text: If the price seems too good to be true on a branded product, you're buying the scam, not the product.

punchline.text: The bargain is real. The product isn't.

quiz.question: How much of global trade involves counterfeit goods?
